title: KAN-91: Clarify how sleep dates are handled
description: Two documentation fixes from reading the Oura code: the comment on dateOf now says which location the date is read in, and the README says why only the longest long sleep counts.

story.summary: Clarify how sleep dates are handled
story.description:
**As** a reader of the Oura code,

**I want** the date handling explained where it happens,

**So that** nobody has to rediscover it.

## Scope

- Documentation only: the comment on dateOf and the README.

## Acceptance criteria

**Given** the comment on dateOf
**When** a developer reads it
**Then** it says in which location the calendar date is read

**Given** the README's account of which sleep counts
**When** a reader reads it
**Then** it says why only one long sleep counts on a night broken into several
